label: First Article
text: Protection of personal data shall be subject to the provisions of this law.

label: Second Article
text: This Law does not derogate from rights granted by virtue of International treaties and conventions in force in the Kingdom.

label: Third Article
text: To implement provisions of this law, the Board of Directors of Personal Data Protection Authority shall issue the necessary resolutions, in a date no later than six months commencing on the first day of the month immediately following the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

label: Fourth Article
text: The Prime Minister and the Ministers, each in his respective capacity, shall implement the provisions of this Law, which shall come into effect after one year commencing on the first day of the month immediately following the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.
